implementation_rules: Use only this workbook-derived package for these 72 furniture products; do not substitute generated images from the previous packaging-product proposal.
Workbook price column E, bank information and logo are intentionally excluded. Do not derive or publish a price. Do not enable zero-price checkout.
Match images using the exact supplied product reference; do not pair by similar product titles. Image anchors for four entries start in the preceding row but physically occupy the correct row.

Correct the image-description conflicts explicitly listed, and preserve source_description_tr in a private migration audit. Do not infer material, coating, stock, dimensions or pack quantity from a photograph.
Dimensions without an explicit unit remain raw source notation; do not silently assume cm. First/second axis order is not confirmed.
Images with multiple views/colours show supplier catalogue alternatives, not necessarily a bundle. Props, decor, plants and other room furniture are not included unless confirmed.
Reuse suitable current website categories, especially office furniture; do not put garden furniture, mirrors or decorative clocks into packaging categories.

Reconcile existing site products before creating records, to prevent duplicates. import_reference is a package key, not a supplier SKU. Preserve existing prices and inventory privately if matching existing products; hide price in this requested display scope.

Upload images to website asset storage and replace local paths with public asset URLs. Use object-fit:contain, preserve aspect ratio and full frame. Do not upscale low-resolution originals or claim HD detail.

Use these four-locale titles and source-backed specifications. Leave absent specifications blank or omit them publicly. For multiple generic titles, the 001-072 suffix is only a catalogue reference, not an official model.
Create the records and preview in draft state with prices hidden; no availability or guaranteed delivery claim before supplier confirmation.
Back up before modifying a project; validate all 72 image links, four locale titles, mobile layout and Arabic RTL. Report before/after matches and unresolved source conflicts.
